rejected.title: Bootstrapped and Need AWS
rejected.reason: The fresh post asks for help scaling on AWS affordably, but states no concrete recurring task, inputs, or bounded output. Proposing a cost or capacity analysis would invent duties absent from the evidence. No supplied implementation reference supports an experiment; a prior assessment of this same post reached a below-threshold result without new task evidence.

steps.message: Assessed the single assigned discussion identity; excluded it because the request is too broad to ground a specific experiment without inventing AWS tasks.
